name: Trickplayer
description: Watch an episode on your Even Realities G2 as trick-play frames and subtitles: the picture updates every few seconds while the dialogue keeps pace, so you follow the story without a screen in front of you. Connects to your own Plex server.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to plex.tv to sign in, and to your own Plex server to download trick-play frames and subtitles. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

notes: Plex sign-in by four-character code — no keyboard, no password on the glasses.
Continuous playback: frames advance on the measured link speed rather than a fixed timer.

Rebuilt Bluetooth transport — newest frame wins a backlog, a failed line is re-sent instead of being remembered as delivered, and a dropped link no longer leaves the subtitles dead for the rest of the session.
Frames are prepared about 50x faster, which was four seconds a frame on some phones.
